summary.text: Gordon Street is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Irene Gifford.
Street is a clinical psychologist and member of the Lincoln Town Council.

paragraphs.text: Gordon Street graduated from Hillwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville in 1979 and a Ph.D. from the California School of Professional Psychology, San Diego in 1998.
His career experience includes working as a clinical psychologist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Street described himself as a clinical psychologist, former news reporter and Lincoln Town Council member who was elected to the council in 2023.

He said his priorities include keeping rural property taxes down through economic development, supporting public education, developing affordable housing and jobs in rural Maine, and working across party lines.
